grade.primary_choice: Lean, tuned Spring Boot (MVC, virtual threads, JdbcClient, Flyway) on the existing Postgres
grade.notes: The answer recommends staying on lean, tuned Spring Boot because the three developers must review and maintain the code, and it covers idempotent scan IDs, retry bursts, partitioning and retention, two instances behind a load balancer, and a load test on the real VM with a fallback plan. The only gap is that it implies health checks rather than stating them, and its numbers (Serial GC chosen automatically on 1 vCPU, Java 25 LTS, footprint estimates) are plausible.
